records.title: FRAPPE: Infusing World Modeling into Generalist Policies via Multiple Future Representation Alignment
records.reason: Read the primary paper sections on FRAPPE method, simulation/inference efficiency, and real-world experiments. It trains a diffusion-based vision-language-action robotic policy using future visual representation alignment; the reported efficiency concerns fine-tuning/data use and its evaluated inference is robotic action generation, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Recurrent-Depth VLA: Implicit Test-Time Compute Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Latent Iterative Reasoning
records.reason: Read the primary paper method, adaptive-computation design, experiments, and limitations. Recurrent-depth VLA allocates iterative latent action-head compute at inference with constant memory, a real test-time compute method; however, it targets continuous robotic actions rather than LLM token generation or serving, leaving transfer to this LLM-inference scope uncertain.

records.title: LIBERO-X: Robustness Litmus for Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: LIBERO-X is a robustness benchmark for robotic VLA policies; it evaluates robustness scenarios rather than improving LLM inference compute, memory, latency, or serving.

records.title: From Self-Evolving Synthetic Data to Verifiable-Reward RL: Post-Training Multi-turn Interactive Tool-Using Agents
records.reason: This paper develops post-training synthetic-data and verifiable-reward RL for interactive tool agents; its contribution is agent training, with no inference-serving or inference-resource method in the primary abstract.

records.title: TeleMem: Building Long-Term and Multimodal Memory for Agentic AI
records.reason: Read the primary memory architecture, experiments, and conclusion. TeleMem is a long-term multimodal memory system for agentic AI, but the reviewed contribution is memory organization/recall and the evidence does not establish a concrete improvement to LLM inference latency, serving throughput, or model/KV memory; relevance to the target efficiency lineage is weak.
